source: the stylesheet bodies read during live signed-out loads of the four public hume.ai surfaces (www.hume.ai marketing/product site, dev.hume.ai docs, the demo.hume.ai invitation gate, the app.hume.ai log-in) — linked bundles from network responses plus inline <style> blocks, re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet. Every custom property is resolved in a probe carrying that surface's own sheets: the docs under <html class="light"> and again under class="dark" (the classes the header Theme menu paints — the only real theme control on any surface), the rest at their painted default (www, demo and app are light-only). `palette` is each surface's harvest of literal colour declarations with the selectors that use them.
